483-2946-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-2946-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
483-2946-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Cruel Celebrant and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1278-3327-4247-4508.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
1278-3327-4247-4508.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1278-3327-4247-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

529-4186-4460-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1531-1981-2415-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

3129-4772-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4993-6893-7282.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
4993-6893-7282.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Manifold Key.
Activate the Manifold Key token by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

792-2292-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
792-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Totentanz and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

465-719-3742-4251-7297.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

864-1312-2034-4460-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

560-2457-4289-4742.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7229.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1385-2921-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-5921-5970-6633.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5702-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1402-2644-3499-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1003-4779-5220-6900.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

628-2438-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-2438-6863--133.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
628-2438-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

509-1267-5143-5547.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-5143-5547.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 5.

2060-2577-6701-6797.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2577-6701-6797.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

2750-4222-6784.description:
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Freed from the Real to become an artifact.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Steelswarm Operator.
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Repeat from step 3.
2750-4222-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Steelswarm Operator's first ability instead.

4053-5499-6633--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5499-6633--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

359-813-2103.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Acrobatic Maneuver.
359-813-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with the persist creature

1856-4050-6249--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and the ability granted to it by Doom Weaver each trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Doom Weaver's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, repairing it and the persist creature.
Repeat.

397-3188-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-3188-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2558-4779-5687-5690.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Ruination Guide, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2741-3097-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-4312-4998.notablePrerequisites:
Savage Thallid has at least three spore counters on it.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1636-4312-4998.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Savage Thallid.
Activate Savage Thallid by removing three spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana and you may target any creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
This combo also nets infinite spore counters on Savage Thallid if it has four or more spore counters to start the combo.

852-905-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Vhati il-Dal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Vhati il-Dal.
852-905-2178.description:
Activate Vhati il-Dal by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying the targeted creature.
When the creature dies, Vhati il-Dal triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this process whenever a creature enters the battlefield.

3750-4228-4366.notablePrerequisites:
Bear Umbra attached to Pako.
You control lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3750-4228-4366.description:
Declare Pako as attacker.
Pako and Bear Umbra triggers.
Resolve the Pako triggers, exiling the top card of each player's library and putting a fetch counter on each of them, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pako for each noncreature card exiled this way.
Resolve the Bear Umbra triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Proceed to your next main phase.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
